job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text: I signed up for the gym membership through the corporate wellness portal last month, but I haven't received the reimbursement yet. The confirmation email said it would be processed within 14 days. Can you check the status of my claim? My employee ID is 4821 and the membership is with FitLife Gym.

Hi, I need to update my direct deposit information for the upcoming payroll. I recently changed banks and want to make sure my salary goes to the new account. Could you let me know what forms I need to fill out and where to submit them? Also, is there a deadline before the next pay period?

On a related note, I've been trying to use the HR chatbot to update my details, but it keeps saying my session has expired. I've tried clearing my browser cache and using a different browser, but no luck. Is there a known issue with the chatbot, or am I doing something wrong?

Finally, I'd like to request a copy of my employment verification letter for a mortgage application. I need it by the end of the week if possible. Thanks!

intent.requested_action: update direct deposit and request employment letter

items.text: When is the next software release scheduled for the expense reporting tool?

I'm trying to plan my team's holiday rota for December, but I'm having trouble finding the policy on carry-over days. The HR portal mentions that unused holiday can be carried over, but it doesn't specify the maximum number of days. Could you clarify? Also, are there any blackout dates for the finance team during year-end close? I want to make sure we have enough coverage. Thanks!

intent.requested_action: clarify holiday carry-over policy and blackout dates

items.text: The automated expense approval system rejected my claim for a client dinner last week. It said the receipt was missing, but I definitely attached it. Can you manually review the claim? The expense ID is EXP-7890. I've also attached the receipt again here. Let me know if you need anything else.

I noticed that the new software release for the payroll system includes changes to the tax calculation. Will there be a training session for the finance team? Also, I heard the chatbot will be updated to answer payroll questions. Will it be able to handle complex queries like multi-state tax scenarios? Just curious about the timeline.

intent.requested_action: ask about training and chatbot capabilities

items.text: My gym membership reimbursement was approved, but the amount is incorrect. I submitted a receipt for $45 per month, but the reimbursement shows $30. Can you check why there's a discrepancy? I've attached the receipt again for reference. Thanks!

I'm working on the holiday rota for my department and need to know how many people can be off at the same time. The policy says 'subject to manager approval' but doesn't give a maximum. Also, can employees swap shifts after the rota is published? I'd like to include this in the team announcement.
I heard that the HR chatbot can now answer questions about benefits. Is that true? If so, what kinds of questions can it handle? I'd like to promote it to my team if it's useful.
Can I get a copy of the holiday rota template in Excel format?
